body:
Reduce JPEG-LS setup overhead while retaining the branch’s predecessor maintenance fixes and owned-storage improvements. Fresh image storage now starts with its private write reservation, metadata checks avoid temporary supported-key sets, gradient tables initialise contiguous intervals, and unary decoding removes a redundant mask. Admission, cancellation, ownership, metadata error precedence and bitstream fidelity remain covered by regression tests.

The confirmed tiny-image preparation-plus-encoding slowdown is fixed: the final candidate/three-change ratio is 0.9556 with simultaneous interval 0.9274–0.9873. Final short-run qualification remains partial at **45/48 passing, three unresolved, zero confirmed regressions**. The unresolved comparisons are p12-ramp preparation and p12-noise preparation versus the pinned predecessor, and p12-noise decoding versus the three-change baseline. All **60 larger-image pooled timing ratios** are below 1.05 across the fixed 120-process guard. These are shared-host measurements; resident services remained active at the owner’s request. Four larger-image pairs provide descriptive evidence, not a population confidence claim. Earlier results and failed/partial attempts remain preserved separately.

Final-source validation:

- 152 tests pass separately in debug, release, ASan and TSan on the host and virtualised native macOS 26.0 guest; 27 named suites, 28 XML classname groups.
- 73 payload and 103 process CLI checks, 990 independent interoperability checks, five exact OS 26.0 simulator consumers, four simulator resource workloads and Apple SDK/Watch arm64_32 builds pass. The native missing-installer packaging failure is retained alongside the successful CLI-only retry.
- Linux workspace attribution covers 89 profiles, with 20 copy checks passing. Each of 20 encode profiles removes one 128-byte metadata Set allocation. The corrected classifier, source/binary identities, raw evidence, independent replays and publication transformations are documented.

Apple RSS noninferiority and a universal heap/stack/allocator workspace maximum remain unresolved (`peakWorkspaceBytes = nil`). All physical-device testing remains pending; milestone 5 is deferred. This PR does not claim full milestone 4 completion or release readiness.

See [validation](https://github.com/raster-labs/SwiftJLS/blob/72a9184ae8879fd77364b60a8059d4ad5bc447d4/Documentation/Engineering/CodecMigration/Validation.md), [performance](https://github.com/raster-labs/SwiftJLS/blob/72a9184ae8879fd77364b60a8059d4ad5bc447d4/Documentation/Engineering/CodecMigration/Milestone4Performance.md), [workspace accounting](https://github.com/raster-labs/SwiftJLS/blob/72a9184ae8879fd77364b60a8059d4ad5bc447d4/Documentation/Engineering/CodecMigration/WorkspaceAccounting.md), and [completion boundaries](https://github.com/raster-labs/SwiftJLS/blob/72a9184ae8879fd77364b60a8059d4ad5bc447d4/Documentation/Engineering/CodecMigration/Completion.md).

The owner verifies CI on the pushed head and merges in GitHub.
title: Reduce codec setup overhead and migrate predecessor fixes
